senses.gloss:
औष्ट्र a. (ष्ट्री f.) [उष्ट्र-अण्]
1
Relating to, or produced from, a
[]
camel.
--2 Abounding in camels.
--ष्ट्रं
1 The milk of a camel.
--2
Camel nature.

औष्ट्रक a. (की f.) [उष्ट्र-वुञ्]
Relating to a camel.
--कं A multitude
of camels; Śi. 5. 65.

औष्ट्ररथ a. (थी f.)
Belonging to a carriage drawn by camels.
